newsitem.title: USA: Pre-Paid Legal CEO to leave company.
newsitem.headline: Pre-Paid Legal CEO to leave company.

text.p: Pre-Paid Legal Services Inc said Tuesday its president and chief executive officer Jack Mildren will leave the company at the end of February to pursue other interests.
Chairman and former Chief Executive Officer Harland Stonecipher will resume the post of chief executive, the legal service plan underwriter and marketer said.
Wilburn Smith will be appointed president and will join the board, replacing Mildren, the company said.

"Wilburn's primary responsibility will be to assist and work with our many key associates all across the United States in the area of recruiting and production of Pre-Paid memberships," Stonecipher said in a news release.
Mildren joined Pre-Paid Legal as president in January 1995 and became chief executive officer in March 1996, the company said.
